dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>I’d resigned myself to being alone in this world forever...
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>But thanks to you, <$cdef(27)>, it seems
Pokémon
are
coming back!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>I really can’t thank you enough.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>Eu tinha me resignado a ficar sozinho neste mundo para sempre...
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>Mas graças a ti, <$cdef(27)>Parece que sim.
Pokémon
are
A voltar!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,1)>Realmente não posso agradecer - lhe o suficiente.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>And as a token of my gratitude, I have a present for you.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>E como prova da minha gratidão, tenho um presente para ti.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Ta-da!
<$voicel(1,6)>What do you think?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Ta-da!
<$voicel(1,6)>O que achas?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Hohoho! This isn’t the type of thing you can carry around
in your bag.
<$voicel(1,5)>It’s called a “chair.” Humans used to sit on these <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>when
they were tired.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Since you’ve been running around all this time in the
shape of a human, I thought it would be perfect for you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Hohoho! Este não é o tipo de coisa que você pode carregar
Na tua mala.
<$voicel(1,5)>É chamado de “cadeira”. Os humanos costumavam sentar-se sobre estes <$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>quando
Estavam cansados.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Desde que você tem corrido todo este tempo no
forma de um humano, eu pensei que seria perfeito para você!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)>I actually used to live with a human myself, a looong, long
time ago.
<$voicel(1,5)>This chair belonged to that human, so it’s got a lot of
memories attached to it.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>It’s a hair small for me to use, though, so I’m giving it
to you. <$voicel(1,10)>Please take good care of it.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)>Eu vivia com um humano, um looong, longo.
Há muito tempo.
<$voicel(1,5)>Esta cadeira pertencia àquele humano, por isso tem um monte de
memórias ligadas a ele.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>É um cabelo pequeno para eu usar, no entanto, então eu estou dando
a ti. <$voicel(1,10)>Por favor, cuide bem dele.

dialogues.en: You used <$cdef(27)>Stockpile</color>!
dialogues.pt_br: Usaste... <$cdef(27)>Stockpile</color>!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>Wha—?! Were you even listening to me?! Chairs are
NOT food!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,4)>O que...?! Você estava sequer me ouvindo?!
Não é comida!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Well, I’ll be... So you can store items inside your body, eh?
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Seems like a mighty handy skill to have!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Would you mind <$cdef(27)>placing that chair down around here?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Bem, eu vou ser... para que você possa armazenar itens dentro do seu corpo, hein?
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Parece uma habilidade muito útil para se ter!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Importas-te? <$cdef(27)>Colocando essa cadeira aqui em baixo.?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,824)>Could you <$cdef(27)>put the chair down over here</color>, please?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,824)>Poderias... <$cdef(27)>Põe a cadeira aqui em baixo.</color>Por favor?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>You sure set that chair down awfully far away. It’d be
easier to chat if you put it a bit closer.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>Você certamente colocar essa cadeira para baixo terrivelmente longe. Seria
É mais fácil conversar se o puser um pouco mais perto.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Now then, go ahead and <$cdef(27)>sit on the chair</color>.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Agora, vá em frente e <$cdef(27)>sentar-se na cadeira</color>.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)>You know, I think I’ll take a bit of a rest too.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)>Acho que vou descansar um pouco também.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)>Go ahead and sit on the chair.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,38)>Sente-se na cadeira.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,17)>Phew... It’s been ages since I’ve talked this much. I’ve
gone and tired myself out.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,17)>Ufa... Faz muito tempo desde que eu falei tanto.
Fui e cansei-me.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)>Brrr...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>It’s a bit chilly now that the sun’s gone down.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,23)><$motion(1,807)>Brrr...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)><$motion(1,661)>Está um pouco frio agora que o sol se pôs.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>You know, humans made handy tools to keep both heat
and cold at bay.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)>sabe, os humanos fizeram ferramentas úteis para manter ambos os calores.
e frio na baía.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>It looks like you’re better at transforming into a human
than you are at transforming into Pokémon...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Maybe that means you’ll be just as good as a human at
making fancy tools too.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Parece que você é melhor em transformar-se em um humano
do que está a transformar-te em Pokémon...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Talvez isso signifique que você será tão bom quanto um humano em
Fazendo ferramentas chiques também.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Hohoho!
<$voicel(1,5)>If you could use that special power of yours to create
more nice places for Pokémon to live, <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,668)>that would really
warm my heart!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Hohoho!
<$voicel(1,5)>Se você pudesse usar esse seu poder especial para criar
lugares mais agradáveis para Pokémon viver, <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,668)>que realmente iria
Aqueça o meu coração!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,9)>’Scuse me, can I tell you something? I found something
weird!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,9)>Com licença, posso dizer-lhe uma coisa?
Estranho!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)>Follow me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)>Sigam-me!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Hohoho! What do you suppose <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur’s found?
<$voicel(1,6)>Why not go along with them and see?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>O que é que achas? <$cdef(27)>BulbasaurFoi encontrado?
<$voicel(1,6)>Por que não vai com eles e vê?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,3)>This way!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,3)>Por aqui!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>Brrr! It’s so cold...
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>Brrr! Está tão frio...

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,801)>See? This thing! What do you think it is?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)><$motion(3,801)>Esta coisa, o que achas que é?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,4)>I think it’s...hmmm...<wait(0.4)><$comeff(3,3)>a bed for napping!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,7)><$facial(3,4)>Eu acho que é ... hmmm ...<wait(0.4)><$comeff(3,3)>Uma cama para dormir!

dialogues.en:
This is a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(764)>.

learned the <$cdef(27)>recipe!

Isto é... <$cdef(27)><$ifull(764)>.
Você pode fazer todos os tipos de itens aqui, desde que você tem

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,803)>Huh? You’re gonna make something here?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,8)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,803)>Vais fazer alguma coisa aqui?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)>Wow, that’s sooo cool! Um...what is it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,3)><$motion(3,801)>Uau, isso é tão legal! Um ... o que é?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)>Do you think the <$cdef(27)>professor</color>’ll know?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,29)>Achas que... <$cdef(27)>professor</color>'saberá?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,32)>Come on, let’s go show that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> you made to
the <$cdef(27)>professor!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,32)>Venha, vamos mostrar que <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> Você fez para
a <$cdef(27)>professor!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>My word, is that...a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>?
<$motion(1,801)>Thank you so much—just as I was really starting to shiver!
<$voicel(1,6)>Could you set it down here?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)>Meu Deus, isso é... <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>?
<$motion(1,801)>Muito obrigado - assim como eu estava realmente começando a tremer!
<$voicel(1,6)>pode pô-lo aqui?

dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)>Por favor, traga o <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)> </color>Só um pouco mais perto.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,803)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Professor</color>, what IS this thing?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,9)><$comeff(3,6)><$motion(3,803)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Professor</color>O que é esta coisa?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>This here is called a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>.
<$voicel(1,5)>It makes the area bright and warm. <$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>Brrr!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>Isto aqui é chamado de <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>.
<$voicel(1,5)>Torna a área brilhante e quente. <$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>Brrr!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)>Huh. But it’s not very warm, is it?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)>Mas não está muito quente, pois não?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,827)>Quite right. Now that I think about it, the fire’s not
actually lit. <$motion(1,654)>A <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> needs fire!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,827)>Muito bem. Agora que eu penso sobre isso, o fogo não
Na verdade, iluminada. <$motion(1,654)>A <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> Precisa de fogo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,17)>But it could be a wee bit challenging for us to start a fire
on our own...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,17)>Mas pode ser um pouco desafiador para começarmos um incêndio.
Por nossa conta...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,48)>I know somebody who can spit out fire! ...I haven’t seen
them around here, though.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,5)><$emotion(3,48)>Eu conheço alguém que pode cuspir fogo! ...Eu não vi
Mas eles estão por aqui.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Oho! You’ve got a friend who can do that, have you?
<$voicel(1,7)>What sort of place did they live in?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,801)>Oho! Você tem um amigo que pode fazer isso, não é?
<$voicel(1,7)>Em que tipo de lugar moravam?

<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)><$comeff(3,3)>Well, um, you know the plot of tall grass that
<$cdef(27)>
made
for
me?
<$voicel(3,10)>It
was
like that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)><$comeff(3,3)>Bem, sabe o terreno de relva alta que...
<$cdef(27)>
fabricado
em vez
Eu?
<$voicel(3,10)>Ele
foi

plot
of
tall

<$voicel(1,6)>like
the
home
you
made

erva,

<$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Could you please make <$cdef(27)>another plot of tall grass, like the
home you made for <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur?
<$voicel(1,9)>A Pokémon who can make fire might come by if you do.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Pode, por favor, fazer <$cdef(27)>outro parcela de grama alta, como o
casa que você fez para <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur?
<$voicel(1,9)>Um Pokémon que possa fazer fogo pode aparecer se o fizeres.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,3)>Aww, the <$cdef(27)>professor </color>looks so cold.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,4)><$emotion(3,3)>Aww, o <$cdef(27)>professor </color>Parece tão frio.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Huh? You want me to light a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>quer que eu acenda um... <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,1)>Sure thing! Stuff like that’s no problem for me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,1)>Claro! Coisas como essa não é problema para mim!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)>Just take me to the <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> and watch me shine!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)>Leva-me ao... <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color> e vê-me brilhar!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)>Take me to that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)>Leva-me a isso. <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, a <$cdef(27)>Charmander’s here to help, eh?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Then lead <$cdef(27)>Charmander to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>!

dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,14)>Oh, sim! <$cdef(27)>Charmander</color>Levem-nos para o <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!

dialogues.en: <$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>How’s that? I lit the fire for you!
dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Que tal isso? Eu acendi o fogo para você!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>Oho! With that, the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> is complete! Thank you,
<$cdef(27)>Charmander! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>What a welcome warmth!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,22)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>Com isso, o... <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> está completo! Obrigado,
<$cdef(27)>Charmander! <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>Que calor bem - vindo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>Now that it’s gotten dark, why don’t we call it a day and
get some rest? <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)>Thank you for the help, everyone—truly!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>Agora que ficou escuro, por que não encerramos um dia e
Descansar? <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)>Obrigado pela ajuda, todos – verdadeiramente!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)>By the by, I noticed you’ve been transformed into a human
this whole time.
<$voicel(1,7)>Could it be that you really miss the human you look like?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,827)>Já agora, notei que você se transformou em um humano
Este tempo todo.
<$voicel(1,7)>Será que sentes mesmo falta do humano que pareces?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,654)>Mm-hmm. I understand. <$motion(1,824)>A long time ago... A very looong
time ago...<$voicel(1,6)>there was a human I spent all my time with.
<$voicel(1,9)>Beloved by everyone—humans and Pokémon alike.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,654)>Eu compreendo. <$motion(1,824)>Há muito tempo atrás... um looong
Há muito tempo atrás...<$voicel(1,6)>Havia um humano com quem passei todo o meu tempo.
<$voicel(1,9)>Amados por todos – humanos e Pokémon igualmente.

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,826)>I don’t know. But I do have a theory.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,826)>Eu não sei. Mas eu tenho uma teoria.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>You’ve started creating some comfortable habitats for
Pokémon, and as a result, <$voicel(1,8)>they’ve begun coming back
here, right?
<$voicel(1,5)>I’d wager that it’ll work the same for humans.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)>Você começou a criar alguns habitats confortáveis para
Pokémon, e como resultado, <$voicel(1,8)>eles começaram a voltar
Aqui, certo?
<$voicel(1,5)>Eu apostaria que vai funcionar o mesmo para os humanos.

dialogues.en:
